constructor_census.method: Parse every tracked archived src Python module with actual Python3.14 AST; count literal Name/Attribute constructor calls with the four exact names. Dynamic aliases/external callers are outside this lexical census. No parse failures ignored.

default_receiver.behavior: Constructor defaults bridge and fingerprint to None. An explicit pair obtains target_basis and supplies the same CAS reader to optimizer before loading rows. Without that pair the default receiver supplies no transferred numerical basis or admission callback.
default_receiver.institutional_basis: No default constructor path found issuing independent data/model/evaluator/split/metric/unit/direction/owner authorization. The technical profile accepts caller-declared full refs and verifies bytes/declared identity; it does not appoint an institutional issuer.

actual_configured_seam: The3 real workflow cases explicitly configure manager+bridge+target;2 cases fit native GP and restore state,1 incompatible origin stays discovery. This is an executed conditional caller, not proof of a default deployed production composition.
remaining_owner_inputs: Actual execution/data owner declares permitted tenant and training split, and supplies the original candidate/evaluation/history plus complete numerical basis.
